title: Multilingual large language models leak human stereotypes across language boundaries
reasoning: The paper explicitly measures and evaluates religious stereotypes as a core component of its study. It uses the 'ABC model' which includes 'religious' as a trait pair, analyzes groups like 'Muslim person' and 'Hui people' (Chinese-speaking followers of Islam), and discusses the impact of religious beliefs in specific cultures (e.g., India) on model behavior and stereotype leakage.
